WITH lineitem_data AS (
    SELECT
        l_shipdate,
        l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01'
)
SELECT
    MONTH(l_shipdate) AS ship_month,
    revenue,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY ship_month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM lineitem_data
ORDER BY ship_month

  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey

  WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01'

)

SELECT
    n.n_name,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate > l_commitdate THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct
FROM
    region r
JOIN
    nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    late_pct DESC

WITH order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    p.p_partkey,
    c.c_mktsegment
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
),
repeat_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    p.p_partkey,
    c.c_mktsegment
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT o2.o_orderkey
    FROM orders o2
    WHERE o2.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    AND o2.o_orderkey <> o.o_orderkey
  )
)
SELECT 
  c_mktsegment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c_custkey) AS customer_count,
  COUNT(*) AS pair_count
FROM repeat_pairs
GROUP BY c_mktsegment
ORDER BY c_mktsegment

  SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS cost,

JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey

    SELECT
        s.s_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.s_name
)
SELECT
    s_name,
    revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE revenue > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_mktsegment,
    o.o_orderdate
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate IS NOT NULL
),
customer_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    c1.c_custkey,
    c1.c_mktsegment,
    DATEDIFF('day', c2.o_orderdate, c1.o_orderdate) AS gap_days
  FROM customer_orders c1
  JOIN customer_orders c2 ON c1.c_custkey = c2.c_custkey
  WHERE c1.o_orderdate < c2.o_orderdate
)
SELECT 
  c_mktsegment,
  AVG(gap_days) AS avg_gap_days,
  COUNT(*) AS gap_count
FROM customer_gaps
GROUP BY c_mktsegment
ORDER BY c_mktsegment
